name: @retreever/create-rapper
_why: THE THIN RAPPER. A SvelteKit config, an app shell, and the children — nothing else. Every script and dependency here must be traceable to something this project actually runs. Deps went 91 -> 43 -> 20 across the RAPPER strip; the ones that vanished were auth, payments, Postgres, express, an unused UI kit, Capacitor (no capacitor.config here), Prisma (no schema here), Tailwind/PostCSS (no @tailwind directive anywhere in src/) and the whole eslint/prettier set (no lint config file exists, so `npm run lint` could never have run). See RAPPER.md.
_why_tailwind_correction: ⚠️ CORRECTED 27 Aug 2026, RE-MEASURED 28 Aug 2026 on dev — `_why` ABOVE IS WRONG ABOUT TAILWIND/POSTCSS. It lists them among the RAPPER strip's casualties, justified with "no @tailwind directive anywhere in src/". That sentence is TRUE AND MEANINGLESS: Tailwind v4 — the version installed here — replaced `@tailwind base;` with `@import 'tailwindcss'`. The check looked for v3 syntax in a v4 project, found nothing, and read absence as proof of disuse. It is the same shape as RULE 7's stripComment() cutting each line at `//`, which is also what `https://` contains: a check that CANNOT FIRE, reported as a pass. RE-MEASURED 28 Aug 2026 on this branch, all still true: this file declares tailwindcss ^4.3.3, @tailwindcss/postcss ^4.3.3, postcss ^8.5.26, tailwind-merge ^3.4.0 and tailwindcss-animate ^1.0.7; src/lib/core/base.css:5 and retreeved/app.css:5 both `@import 'tailwindcss'`; ReTreever_who_what/lib/cn.ts:18 calls twMerge(clsx(inputs)); postcss.config.js loads @tailwindcss/postcss. THE COUNT: `_why` says deps went 91 -> 43 -> 20. On main that total had drifted back ABOVE 20 and this note flagged it as suspect; dev has since stripped further and it is now 19 (5 dependencies + 14 devDependencies). Either way the lesson stands — the number is a snapshot, not a fact, so COUNT before quoting it. WHAT IS STILL TRUE: the strip itself happened, and the OTHER casualties named (auth, payments, Postgres, express, Capacitor, Prisma, the eslint/prettier set) are genuinely gone. Only the Tailwind/PostCSS clause is false. KEPT rather than edited into `_why`, because the wrong sentence is the useful part: anyone who greps `@tailwind`, finds nothing, and concludes 'unused' is about to delete a live dependency. See the matching correction in retreeved/app.tokens.css.
_why_prepublishOnly: A PUBLISH THAT CANNOT INSTALL MUST NOT LEAVE THIS MACHINE. gitEr/packTest.sh packs this package, unpacks the tarball into a temp dir with no workspace above it, runs `npm create`, then installs and builds EVERY child, and finally checks that spread-children.mjs can lay all of them down. The tarball is the only artifact a stranger ever sees, and until 27 Aug 2026 nothing tested it: the create path had run once, by hand, on one machine, and had accumulated four defects nobody had noticed — including getCache_OfflineMap being unbuildable from the package outright. WHY prepublishOnly AND NOT prepack: packTest.sh itself runs `npm pack`, so hanging it off prepack would recurse. prepublishOnly runs first and to completion, and its inner pack cleans up after itself before the outer one starts. It also runs ONLY on publish, never on a plain `npm pack` or an install, which is what keeps it off contributors' machines. COST: several minutes and roughly 2GB of free disk, because every child gets a real node_modules. That is the price of knowing. `npm publish --ignore-scripts` skips it, and doing so means publishing something no one has proven installs.

scripts._why_predev: RAPPER SERVES ITS OWN ASSETS. The mounted child asks for /mobileAssets/... — pins, the worldBase basemap tiles, the map glyphs — and rapper had no static/ at all, so every one of them 404'd here while working under ReTreever. MEASURED 27 Aug 2026: pin_default_sm.webp, worldBase/base/tiles/6/18/23.pbf and glyphs/Noto Sans Regular/0-255.pbf were all 404 on 5174 and 200 on 5173, same URL, same bytes on disk. A pin rendered as a broken-image square. The child cannot reach across into a parent for them — it names no parent, and src/lib/guards/noEscapePlugin.ts throws on the raw climb at build time — so the parent must FILL THE SEAM, exactly as it does for $parent/retreeved. The 49 MB it copies is gitignored: ReTreever/static/mobileAssets stays the single source of truth. ⚠️ CORRECTED 28 Aug 2026 — THIS LINE USED TO NAME A CHILD. It read `bash ../getCache_OfflineMap/fetchAssets.sh static/mobileAssets`, and a wrapper mounts exactly ONE child chosen at install time, so that name was right for one install and wrong for every other. MEASURED against the published 0.1.2, installed from the registry: `npm run dev` died with `bash: ../getCache_OfflineMap/fetchAssets.sh: No such file or directory`, exit 127 — a failing pre-script aborts the script it precedes, so vite never started. Only 1 of the 4 children ships a fetchAssets.sh, so it was wrong for three quarters of installs. It now runs scripts/childAssets.mjs, which reads the mounted child from kit.files.routes and names none. WHY NO GATE CAUGHT IT: packTest.sh runs `npm install` and `npm run build`; `predev` only fires on `npm run dev`, which nothing tests.

description: A SvelteKit rapper that runs any one of ReTreever and Get Cache's component repos on its own.
